lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Vanessa Pawar is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Vanessa is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
d41: 🕯️ Vanessa Pawar is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Vanessa kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Vanessa's gone." Lucas looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Vanessa." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
